page.layout: One page of text; marginal notes in the right margin (Enallage generis, Pronom. primitiva, Possessiva). Running head at top, page number 271 at top right.

main_text.p: τὸ τ᾽ ἀνθρώπῳ ἁπτικόν, pro ἡ τῆ ἀνθρώπῳ ἁπτική, τὸ ἀλαθὸν τῆς, pro ἡ ἀληθότης τῆς.
Item pro masculino & fœminino elegantèr utūtur neutro, Enallage generis. δικαιοπραγίας ... ἀδικία ... Λεώτρον δικαιοσύνης, ἡ φύσις ὅτι φιλότιμον.
Iungitur in hoc schemate interdum plurale cum singulari, χρήσιμον εἰς αἰωνεῖ-αν αἰ ὑνσεῖαι, quæ locutiones Emphasim quandam habent.
main_text.head: CONSTRVCTIO PRONOMINVM.
Speciei Enallage.
main_text.p: ENITIVI pronominum primitivorum pro Possessiuis sumuntur, πατήρ μου, pro πατὴρ ὁ ἐμὸς, πατὴρ ἡμῶν, pro πατὴρ ὁ ἡμέτερος. Pronom. primitiva
main_text.head: Possessiua.
main_text.p: Possessiua adsciscunt quandoque genitiuum, Lucian. ὅλως δὲ τὰ μὰ ἕτοι ἀπα-δῶσι τῆ κακοδαίμονι, hi prorsus mea in fœlicis dilapidant, ἐμὸν αὐτοῦ βίον, meam ipsius uitam. Possessiua

page.notes: Greek text is partly uncertain in places; the decorative woodcut initial at the start of "ENITIVI" is a printer's ornament. Marginal note positions are approximate.
